mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_id,status,revision,favorite,current_version_id,version_number,created_at,updated_at FROM question WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id,question_id,owner_id,version_number,title,prompt_json,standard_status,has_reference,created_at FROM question_version WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND question_id=#{id} AND id=#{versionId}
SELECT topic_id FROM question_version_topic WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY position_index
SELECT knowledge_item_id AS item_id,knowledge_version_id AS version_id FROM question_knowledge_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY position_index
SELECT reference_answer,checkpoints_json FROM question_version WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND question_id=#{id} AND id=#{versionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET current_version_id=#{versionId},version_number=#{number},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected}
UPDATE question SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected}
UPDATE question SET favorite=#{favorite},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected}
